## Krea 2 Turbo API

Krea 2 Turbo is an image generation model by Krea, available on the Venice API as `krea-2-turbo`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### Krea 2 Turbo API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `krea-2-turbo` | Generate | Private | $0.04 / image |

### Krea 2 Turbo specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Krea |
| Released | Jun 30, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 5:4, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 9:21 |
| Prompt limit | 5,000 characters |

### How to use the Krea 2 Turbo API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "krea-2-turbo"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "krea-2-turbo",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
